title: Equal tokens do not share mutable activations
purpose: Preserve token order and repetition when gathering a sequence into new storage.
contract: Tokens [1,0,1] produce canonical X [3,4] with strides [4,1].
Rows 0 and 2 have equal values, but mutating one cannot mutate the other.
